summary: [spec fidelity, P3] The Then of change.drop.26 says the preview 'writes nothing'. In change_drop_26_migrate_adds_the_change_state_route_line_and_the_next_plan_is_empty, the check labelled 'a preview writes nothing' (migrate.rs:923) runs before the first `canon migrate --json` preview (migrate.rs:924). Nothing compares canon.yaml after that preview, and ok_commit runs its own preview, so a preview that wrote the line would still pass. Fix: move the assert_eq of line 923 to after the preview at line 924 (test only), or drop 'and writes nothing' from the Then.
